text:
Three students are describing the structure of an atom.
student 1
All the positively charged particles are in the nucleus.
student 2
Positive electrons are in the nucleus.
student 3
Negative electrons orbit around the nucleus.
Which students are making a correct statement?
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Physics
